description: Branch protection rules: require pull requests and 2 approving reviews. Includes payload examples for both the Branch Protection API and the Repository Rulesets API. Includes a repository-level ruleset that targets all branches and disallows force pushes.

global_settings.note: To disallow force pushes across all branches, use the repository rulesets API with conditions.ref_name.include = ['~ALL'] (this object). Some fields for force-push blocking are applied via branch protection APIs per-branch; when using rulesets, the platform enforces non-fast-forward protections.

usage.branch_protection_api_instructions: Use the 'branch_protection_api.protection' object as the body for PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection (requires admin access).
usage.repository_rulesets_api_instructions: Use the 'repository_rulesets_api' object as the body for POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets to create a ruleset that targets all branches (~ALL). Ensure Accept: application/vnd.github+json and proper auth.
